questions.stem: What is a key feature of a sole proprietorship?

options.text: Owned and operated by one person

questions.explanation: A sole proprietorship is owned and operated by one person, who has full control over the business. This is a defining characteristic of this type of business organisation.

distractorRationale.b: Limited liability is a feature of companies, not sole proprietorships.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about partnerships?

options.text: Partners are not liable for business debts.

distractorRationale.a: Partners are personally liable for business debts.
distractorRationale.c: Partnerships do not necessarily require government approval to start.
distractorRationale.d: Decision-making is usually shared among partners.

questions.stem: What does limited liability mean for company shareholders?

options.text: They are responsible for all company debts.
Their personal assets are protected from company debts.
They must manage the company's daily operations.
They receive all the company's profits.

questions.explanation: Limited liability means that shareholders' personal assets are protected from the company's debts. They are only liable up to the amount they invested.

distractorRationale.a: Shareholders are not responsible for all company debts.
distractorRationale.c: Shareholders do not necessarily manage daily operations.
distractorRationale.d: Profits are shared among all shareholders, not given to one.
